servinfo.title: Description of Speed Limiter System Cancel Conditions
servinfo.ptxt: Speed limiter system is canceled under one of the following conditions.

item.ptxt: Unit of vehicle speed in information display is switched between km/h and mile/h.
Adaptive cruise control system is turned ON.

attention3.ptxt: When speed limiter control is canceled due to a condition with * (asterisk), the maximum speed before cancellation can be resumed by operating RES/+ switch.
